assign.outcome:
**What landed** — [report.md](/framework/ai/2026-09-29/servex-mastermind/audit/skills/report.md): 4 tables (inventory, invocations, trigger gaps, stale/missing) plus 3 findings, read-only.

- new-task fired 1 time while 146 task dirs opened this week; new-page fired 5 times while 103 page.js files landed. Real gaps, only partly explained by the hook's own chicken-and-egg hole (new-task creates the very file the hook logs into).
- Orchestrator skills (mastermind, sub-mastermind, servex-mastermind, master-assistant, log-assistant, every-prompt) show zero logged calls — not because they're unused, but because they run from a launch prompt outside any open task, so the current per-task Skill-hook log structurally cannot see them. That's the headline finding: verification only covers half the skill roster.
- Two small housekeeping items: `.claude/skills/assistant/` is a dead dir (no SKILL.md, holds only `say.mjs`, superseded by every-prompt); `.claude/skills/openrouter/` is untracked in git.
- Left alone: no missing-skill pattern found in any improvements.md touched this week.
